title: ✨ Magical, romantic and with unlimited CAVA: the best of Barcelona ✨
text:
An absolutely amazing experience! I can't recommend it enough.

The boat is beautiful, clean and very comfortable. We leave just at golden hour and sunset from the sea with the profile of Barcelona in the background... just STUNNING. The views of the Mediterranean, the city and the sunset are postcard.

And the unlimited cava is no joke: the service was attentive, fast and they never let our glass be empty. The cava was fresh and good quality. The whole atmosphere on board was super cheerful, relaxed and with good background music.

Lluís, the captain was charming, friendly and very profession

title: You think so? A different (and beautiful) way to see Barcelona
text:
We booked a sunset ride with Enjoy Sailing BCN and the experience was amazing. Everything was easy from the beginning: booking, communication with the team and punctuality. You can tell they have everything very well organized.

The sailboat was spotless and the atmosphere was very relaxed, just what we were looking for. Being able to see the city from the sea, as the sun goes down, with good music and a glass of wine in hand... was just perfect.

The pattern was super nice, made us feel comfortable from minute one, and told us curiosities of the city without being heavy or touristic.

We love
